approval.evidence: resolve the gap, and approve plan 27

title: Restyle the screens to the board look (the kit)
problem: The approved plans cover the guide, the board and the opening scene. Nobody yet restyles the other screens (buttons, chips, cards, panels, the dark information layer) to the board look, so the game would be half old and half new.
scope: Buttons, chips, cards, panels, inputs and toggles restyled to the kit: cream mat surfaces, ink outlines, pill buttons, coin-shaped prices
Dark navy kept only for the evening phase and overlays
Screen by screen: home, set-up, the table, morning card, showdown, results, settings, how to play
Pixel icons in place of the remaining emoji (if PLAN-027 has not done it)
Order of work: after PLAN-027 (done) and before PLAN-029 and PLAN-030
Fix every sprite size on the screens to the allowed list and empty the baseline in tests/sprite-sizes.test.ts
Merge the older c_xxxxxx palette colours into the guide roles
exclusions: Layout changes beyond what the kit needs
New artwork other than the kit pieces

acceptance.text: Every screen uses the palette, radii and outlines in docs/ART-STYLE.md (a check lists any stray values)
No screen is harder to read or to tap than before (contrast and 44 px targets checked)
Phone look checked on the home, set-up, table and results screens
Lint, types, unit tests, build and browser tests pass
All sprites render at allowed sizes: the baseline list in tests/sprite-sizes.test.ts is empty
